description: One agent's monthly token budget and run cap and what it has used this UTC month, counted from its Run records (state: unlimited, ok, warning, paused, not_measured). `tokens.used` is null, never 0, when the runs' tool reported no usage, and a partial total is a lower bound ("at least"). The numbers are measured, not estimates. A budget is raised with update_record on the agent's record (a person can; an agent cannot change its own). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES get_agent_budget"]

agent.description: The agent record's uuid (from the Agents database; list_agent_wakes and get_agent_wake_summary show it).

name: get_agent_budget
title: An agent's monthly budget and usage
